title: AxIoU: An Axiomatically Justified Measure for Video Moment Retrieval

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: Moreover, R@K, θ evaluates rather different aspects of system quality depending on a parameter setting and can conflict with each other; for example, a ranked list whose second moment achieves IoU = 0.71 is measured to be 1.0 in terms of 21076 R@2, 0.7 but to be 0.0 in terms of R@1, 0.7 when the first moment has IoU = 0.69.
